title: Subcortical affect comes in homeostatic, sensory and emotional forms

statements.text: Subcortical affects come in three categories: homeostatic bodily drives such as hunger and thermoregulation, sensory affects that help regulate them such as the feel of taste, cold and warmth, and the instinctual emotional networks that give ambulant organisms their action tools, namely SEEKING, LUST, FEAR, RAGE, CARE, PANIC/GRIEF and PLAY.

sources.quote: subcortical affective processes come in at least three major categorical forms
